title: Investigation core: 4 areas + per-area zod findings + pure deterministic grader
rationale: trellis-4ba0 builds src/investigation/ as the agent→facts→grade seam (SPEC §7). areas.ts: AREA_IDS/AREAS keyed by the rubric 'investigation' values (documentation/agent-config/setup-runnability/test-layout); each Area carries id/title/description/facts[]+a prompt rendered by a shared buildPrompt scaffold (read-only mandate, facts-not-verdicts, submit_findings EXACTLY ONCE) so the only per-area variable is the fact list. findings.ts: one z.strictObject per area (strict ALL the way down) so verdict-shaped extras are rejected at the boundary; the §7.2 AgentConfigFindings example is the shape model, finalized for all four; test-layout adds a superRefine (matchingConvention<=fileCount) fact-sanity invariant; FINDINGS_SCHEMAS+AreaFindings map area id→schema/type. grader.ts: pure, no I/O/clock/random. Grade shape mirrors DetectorResult/ScorecardEntry (denominator literal 1, naKind iff numerator null) so agent grades fold into the scorecard on the same path. Per-area typed grader maps (satisfies Record<string,(f)=>Grade>); CRITERION_AREA derived from those maps; gradeArea(area,raw) parses then grades all bound criteria, gradeCriterion(id,raw) grades one. §3.2 enforced structurally: SKIPPABLE_AGENT_CRITERIA={local_services_setup,devcontainer_runnable,flaky_test_detection}; enforceSkippable() throws if a non-skippable criterion grades N/A. Skippable graders emit not-applicable (surface absent) vs no-detector (ambiguous, e.g. devcontainer present but buildability unknown). FRESH_THRESHOLD_DAYS=180 for documentation_freshness. Tests: table-driven (facts→outcome) covering pass/fail/N-A for all 20; determinism (same facts→toEqual); acceptance loads the REAL rubric and asserts gradedCriterionIds()===20 agent ids, CRITERION_AREA matches each criterion.investigation, skippable flags agree.
